title: Platform Readiness Probe Envelope (BUILD-005 Slice 1)
description: Readiness means whether the component can safely perform its currently assigned production responsibility. DEGRADED != NOT_READY. DEGRADED with ready=true and HTTP 200 is permitted when last trusted operating state remains safe. ready=false requires HTTP 503. Compact payload only; no queue dumps, scheduler inventories, or full diagnostics.

status.description: Operational status. DEGRADED may still be ready=true.

ready.description: true when assigned production responsibility remains safe.
